messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 14(6)

Article 14 Obligations of importers of partly completed machinery. 6. Importers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary to bring that partly completed machinery into conformity, to withdraw it or recall it, as appropriate. Furthermore, where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards relevant essential health and safety requirements, importers shall immediately inform the competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the partly completed machinery available on the market to that effect, giving details, in particular, of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken.

response.text:
Importers | mustTakeCorrectiveActions | corrective actions necessary to bring partly completed machinery into conformity, or to withdraw or recall it, as appropriate | importers consider or have reason to believe the machinery placed on the market is not in conformity with the Regulation | "shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary to bring that partly completed machinery into conformity, to withdraw it or recall it, as appropriate"
Importers | mustInformAuthorities | competent national authorities of the Member States where the machinery was made available on the market | partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards relevant essential health and safety requirements | "importers shall immediately inform the competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the partly completed machinery available on the market to that effect"
Importers' notification | mustIncludeDetails | details of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken | notification is made to competent national authorities under the risk condition | "giving details, in particular, of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken"
